source.notes: IMPORTANT SCOPE CAVEAT - read before writing. The Trust publishes TWO selection rounds with two different deadlines for the same open 2027/8 cycle, and a single deadline_date field cannot represent both. deadline_date 2026-10-14 is the US-citizens-resident-in-the-USA round deadline: it is the only single explicit calendar deadline the Trust publishes, it is the first-closing round, and it is still open at the retrieval date. This is NOT a CONFLICTING case: the brief reserves that for two sources disagreeing about the same deadline, whereas here a single source describes two distinct rounds. If the integrator requires one date that is valid for every applicant, treat this record as precision 'varies' instead and use the wording in deadline_display. This is not an inference from University of Cambridge postgraduate funding deadlines; both dates are stated verbatim on the Trust's own Timeline page.

records.title: Young Leaders Program (YLP) Students - Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
records.deadline_display: No central deadline is published. "Recruitment will be conducted through the recommending authorities of each eligible country. Please ask the Japanese Embassy for further information." Applications must "reach your recommending authority by the designated deadline".

source.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
source.as_of: 2027 intake - APPLICATION GUIDELINES JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2027 YOUNG LEADERS' PROGRAM (YLP) STUDENT (SCHOOL OF GOVERNMENT); program commences October 2027
source.raw_extract: 5. Recruitment and Selection (1) Method of Recruitment Recruitment will be conducted through the recommending authorities of each eligible country. Please ask the Japanese Embassy for further information. (2) Screening Procedure 1 First screening by the recommending authorities 2 Second screening by GRIPS 3 Final screening by the YLP committee organized by MEXT ... Notes for application documents (2) A complete set of your required application documents must reach your recommending authority by the designated deadline. Incomplete applications or applications received after the deadline will not be considered.
source.exact_deadline_wording: Applicants must submit ... by the designated deadline
source.notes: This is the primary MEXT document for the 2027 YLP cycle, and it publishes no calendar date, month or window - only 'the designated deadline', which is set by each country's recommending authority. YLP is the one MEXT type with NO embassy-recommendation route: the studyinjapan.go.jp page records 'Embassy recommendation: No' and 'Recommendations from official overseas recommending organizations'. I verified all three 2027 YLP tracks (School of Government, Law, Business Administration) on mext.go.jp and each routes applicants to the embassy/recommending authority with no published date; no explicit application date appears in any of them. The record's own official_source_url (the About Scholarships overview page) contains no timing information either, confirming the record's existing deadline_display. Per the brief I did not use any embassy page (country-specific, and no single country is identified in the record) and did not use search snippets.

records.deadline_display: Student Deadline: Date set by graduate unit (see button above) | Application Dates: Determined by graduate unit | Graduate Unit Deadline: Refer to SGS Memo (not for students - unit must forward all OGS nominations to SGS by this date) | Results: Mid-July

source.publisher: School of Graduate Studies, University of Toronto
source.as_of: Award cycle for 2026-2027 registration (page states eligibility requires registration 'in an eligible program on a full-time basis in 2026-2027')
source.raw_extract: Student Deadline : Date set by graduate unit (see button above) | Application Dates : Determined by graduate unit | Graduate Unit Deadline : Refer to SGS Memo (not for students - unit must forward all OGS nominations to SGS by this date) | Level of Study : Doctoral, Master's | Results : Mid-July ... Each graduate unit will have their own internal submission deadline to which applicants must adhere. ... Important note for prospective students: OGS awards are not transferrable between universities or between graduate units at U of T. Accordingly, students must submit an OGS application to each graduate unit for which they are seeking admission at U of T
source.notes: This is the decisive finding: the University of Toronto deliberately publishes NO single OGS application deadline for the programme. The deadline is set independently by each of 80+ graduate units. The record in this shard is the programme-level OGS, not a named graduate unit's OGS, so no single date is authoritative for it and none was written. I also fetched the SGS OGS Application Instructions page, which repeats the same position ('your graduate unit deadline') and contains no central date. ADDITIONAL STATUS SIGNAL, not a deadline: the schedule SGS links as its 'Student deadlines' button lists per-unit deadlines that run from 15-Dec-2025 to 18-May-2026, and SGS lists Results as 'Mid-July', so the 2026-27 OGS competition appears to have concluded before this retrieval. I did not use that schedule as evidence (see rejected_sources) and I did not derive any date from it.

records.deadline_display: Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline. (No date published.)

source.publisher: Japan Student Services Organization (JASSO), Study in Japan - government-approved information site, hosting the MEXT application guidelines
source.as_of: APPLICATION GUIDELINES JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2027 (UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS) (EMBASSY RECOMMENDATION)
source.raw_extract: 9. SELECTION (1) The Japanese diplomatic missions will conduct the First Screening of applicants through examination of submitted application documents, written academic examinations and interviews. (2) The date and time of the notification of the results of the First Screening will be specified separately by the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country ... (4) Applicants will be informed of the final selection results by the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country after February 2027. ... 10. APPLICATION DOCUMENTS Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the country of the applicant's nationality by the designated deadline. The submitted documents will not be returned.
source.notes: I extracted the full text of all 10 pages of the live 2027 Undergraduate guidelines PDF (the record's catalogue_url) and enumerated its section headings: 1 Definition, 2 Fields of Study, 3 Preparatory Education, 4 Direct Placement, 5 Qualifications and Conditions, 6 Period of Scholarship, 7 Scholarship Benefits, 8 Suspension of Payment, 9 Selection, 10 Application Documents, 11 Unavoidable Circumstances, 12 Notes. There is NO schedule/recruitment-window section in this document - unlike the Research Students guidelines in this same shard, which do carry a dated process chart. The only deadline-related wording is 'by the designated deadline', with the deadline set separately by each embassy; the only dated milestone is 'final selection results ... after February 2027'. CRITICAL FLAG FOR THE INTEGRATOR: the sentence currently stored in this record's deadline_display - 'Recruitment for those arriving in Japan next April is made between April and May of the previous year. First screening is conducted between May and August by the Japanese Embassies or Consulates General.' - does NOT appear anywhere in the live 2027 guidelines PDF I fetched. I could not verify it against the current official document, so per AGENT_BRIEF section 5 I did not carry it forward as evidence and did not convert it into a MONTH value. It may originate from an earlier guideline edition or from another page; it should not be trusted without re-sourcing.

The record's existing deadline_display ('Recruitment for those arriving in Japan in April 2027 or September/October 2027 is made between April and May of the previous year. First screening is conducted between May and July...') is close in substance to the live chart but is not verbatim; the wording in deadline_display above is.

records.deadline_display: Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country by the designated deadline. (No date published.)

source.publisher: Japan Student Services Organization (JASSO), Study in Japan - government-approved information site, hosting the MEXT application guidelines
source.as_of: APPLICATION GUIDELINES JAPANESE GOVERNMENT (MEXT) SCHOLARSHIP FOR 2026 (JAPANESE STUDIES STUDENTS)
source.raw_extract: 6. SELECTION (1) The Japanese diplomatic missions will conduct the First Screening of applicants by means of examination of submitted application documents, a written examination (subject: Japanese) and interviews. (2) The date and time of the notification of the results of the First Screening will be specified separately by the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country; the reasons for the results of the screening will not be disclosed. (4) The results of the final selection will be notified on a date separately designated by the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country. ... 7. APPLICATION DOCUMENTS Applicants must submit the following documents to the Japanese diplomatic mission in the applicant's country by the designated deadline. The submitted documents will not be returned.
source.notes: I extracted the full text of all 9 pages of the live 2026 Japanese Studies Students guidelines PDF (the record's official_source_url and catalogue_url) and enumerated its section headings: 1 Qualifications and Conditions, 2 Placement and Study, 3 Period of Scholarship, 4 Scholarship Benefits, 5 Suspension, 6 Selection, 7 Application Documents, 8 Unavoidable Circumstances. As with the Undergraduate guidelines, there is NO schedule or recruitment-window section: the only deadline wording is 'by the designated deadline', set separately by each embassy. I searched the whole extracted text for any explicit calendar date and every date found is unrelated to applying (arrival window, scholarship period, age cut-offs). CRITICAL FLAG FOR THE INTEGRATOR: the sentence currently stored in this record's deadline_display - 'Recruitment for those arriving in Japan next October is made between December of the previous year and the following February. The first screening is conducted between January and February...' - does NOT appear in the live document, so per AGENT_BRIEF section 5 I did not carry it forward and did not convert it into a MONTH value. STATUS SIGNAL, deliberately not recorded as a deadline: the same document states 'If the accepting university has yet to be determined by the specified period of time (by August 14, 2026), the applicant will be rejected' and sets the scholarship period from October 2026, which indicates the 2026 cycle has concluded and this record is unlikely to be genuinely open. I left outcome as unknown rather than expired_mismatch because the source publishes no application deadline at all, so there is no past deadline to mismatch; the integrator should review the record's open/closed status on that basis.
